question: Does a delivery-% spike (deliv_x20, delivery vs own 20d avg) grade plain 4% up days? Expect higher deliv_x20 = better stop-R (institutional conviction behind the move, not just intraday churn).
plain: Indian brokers report what fraction of a day's shares actually get delivered (held) vs just traded intraday; this checks whether 4% up-days with unusually high delivery (real buying, not noise) work out better than 4% days with low delivery.
